name: Mura Runetotem
summary: At the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest, Mura Runetotem hopes a shell from the Barrens can help the Forsaken.

sections.title: A Bridge Across Seas
sections.body: Around the Barrens oases, Tonga Runetotem studies wildlife changed by magic. The altered snapjaws catch his eye. Their shells pulse with resilient energy despite their corruption. So he asks you to carry one across the Great Sea to his clanmate, Mura Runetotem, stationed in the Eastern Kingdoms.

sections.title: Aiding the Forsaken
sections.body: At the Sepulcher, a Forsaken outpost in Silverpine Forest, Mura Runetotem aids her allies. She made the arduous journey to help them cleanse and renew their ailing, blighted woodland. The shell holds an inner glow and an enduring spark of life. Mura hopes it may reveal how to restore vitality to the northern continent.

faq.answer: Mura Runetotem is a tauren druid and Tonga Runetotem's clanmate. She crossed the sea and settled at the Sepulcher to help the Forsaken find ways to heal their dying forest.
Mura Runetotem is at the Sepulcher, a Forsaken town along the road in central Silverpine Forest, in the Eastern Kingdoms.

faq.q: Why does Tonga want a snapjaw shell sent to Silverpine?
faq.answer: Altered snapjaw shells near the Barrens oases show unnatural vitality and an inner glow. Tonga hopes their resilient life force may help Mura learn how to heal Silverpine Forest's blighted, dying ecology.

faq.q: Why are the tauren trying to heal Forsaken lands?
faq.answer: Tauren hold a sacred duty to nurture and mend the natural world. Seeing Silverpine Forest decaying and blighted, Mura hopes the earth's healing traditions can aid the Horde's new allies and restore balance to the soil.

faq.q: How does this quest connect the Barrens to Silverpine?
faq.answer: The shell's journey carries you from the plains of Kalimdor to the forests of the Eastern Kingdoms, linking early Horde territories.

faq.q: What happens after giving Mura the shell?
faq.answer: Mura is fascinated by the shell's lingering inner glow. She resolves to study it closely as she seeks a remedy for Silverpine's blighted woodlands.

angles.text: As a tauren, you see the Runetotem clan's care for the natural world reach across the sea to Silverpine's withered groves.
As an undead, you may see rot and blight claiming the forest around the Sepulcher. Tauren druids such as Mura Runetotem seek to renew it.
As a druid, you study nature's unusual returns, even those born of strange mutations, to help restore balance to broken lands.
As a member of the Horde, you see its growing bond in the cooperation between Kalimdor's defenders and the Forsaken in Lordaeron.
